## Checklist
- [ ] `make lint typecheck test` pass locally
- [ ] `make eval` passes (fake mode; pipeline logic, not model quality)
- [ ] New env vars / YAML keys documented with comments (drift guard passes)
- [ ] Graph changed? `make docs-graphs` run and node cards updated
- [ ] No personal data, real CVs or secrets (PII guard passes)
- [ ] No invented numbers in docs (measured or "not yet measured")
